keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Manuel Capasso, Atlas. Atlas 0, Pachuca 1.
Alán Bautista (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Atlas 0, Pachuca 2. Oussama Idrissi (Pachuca) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Salomón Rondón.
Delay in match because of an injury Juan Purata (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Aldo Rocha (Atlas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
